activity.notes: The Altai national movement created the Karakorum-Altai District and its executive administration in 1918. Gurkin, already chairman of the Altai Mountain Duma, became chairman of the Karakorum-Altai administration and remained a leading Altai autonomous-state figure until the structure was suppressed during the Civil War.

sources.title: Grigory Ivanovich Choros-Gurkin — Russian Archives Guides
sources.citation_text: The archival guide records Gurkin as chairman of the Altai Mountain Duma in 1917 and chairman of the Karakorum-Altai administration in 1918.
